results.title: Chef Damu dies at 72: Sanjeev Kapoor, Thalapathy Vijay pay tribute to Cooku with Comali judge
results.description: Damodaran Kothandaraman, popularly known as Chef Damu, has died at the age of 72. The Padma Shri recipient, who became a familiar face on Tamil television as a judge on the cooking reality show Cooku with Comali, once set a Guinness World Record by preparing 617 dishes in a single cooking marathon. Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay and celebrity chef Sanjeev Kapoor have paid tribute to him.

results.title: Elena Rybakina crushes Leylah Fernandez to win Ningbo Open title
results.description: World number one Elena Rybakina won her fourth title of an outstanding season with a ruthless straight-sets victory over Leylah Fernandez in the Ningbo Open final on Sunday. The top seed and defending champion cruised to a 6-2, 6-2 win in 73 minutes over the world number 30 from Canada. Rybakina, the Australian and US Open champion, collected her 15th WTA crown in all and went a long way towards securing the year-end number-one ranking. results.title: Netanyahu rebuked for plan to use crypto to bypass economic sanctions
results.description: By Steven Scheer JERUSALEM, Oct 25 (Reuters) - Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who faces re-election this week, is drawing criticism from economists and political rivals after suggesting Israel could use cryptocurrency to help shield its economy from potential international sanctions. In an interview with Israel's Channel 10 on Friday, Netanyahu said he was preparing for a scenario in which broader sanctions were imposed on Israel.
